# Lisbon Portugal Tourism

> > Comprehensive travel guide to Lisbon, Portugal featuring attractions, neighborhoods, itineraries, and day trips throughout the Portuguese capital and surrounding regions.

Lisbon Portugal Tourism provides detailed visitor guides covering historic landmarks, museums, squares, and neighborhoods including Belém, Alfama, and Chiado. The site offers practical travel planning advice, Lisboa Card information, and itineraries for exploring Lisbon and nearby destinations like Sintra and Cascais.

## Key Topics

- Lisbon attractions and landmarks
- Lisboa Card benefits
- Belém district
- Alfama neighborhood
- Chiado and Príncipe Real
- Praça do Comércio
- MAAT and Discoveries Monument
- Parque das Nações and Oceanarium
- Day trips to Sintra and Cascais
- Historic squares and architecture
- Travel itineraries and planning
- Costa da Caparica beaches
- Downtown Lisbon sightseeing
- Museums and palaces
- Portuguese capital tourism

## Essential Travel Planning

- [Trip to Lisbon - Sightseeing Guide and Itinerary Advice](https://www.lisbonportugaltourism.com/guide/): Comprehensive Lisbon trip planning guide with itineraries and attractions

## Historic Landmarks and Squares

- [ROSSIO SQUARE, Lisbon - 2026 Tourist Guide](https://www.lisbonportugaltourism.com/guide/rossio-square.html): Guide to Rossio Square, downtown Lisbon's historic central plaza

## Palaces and Museums

- [AJUDA PALACE and Royal Treasure Museum, Lisbon - 2026 Guide](https://www.lisbonportugaltourism.com/guide/ajuda-palace.html): Guide to Ajuda Palace royal residence and crown jewels museum
- [NATIONAL PANTHEON (Santa Engrácia Church), Lisbon - 2026 Guide](https://www.lisbonportugaltourism.com/guide/national-pantheon.html): Guide to National Pantheon baroque church in Alfama district

## Parks and Gardens

- [BOTANICAL GARDEN, Lisbon - 2026 Tourist Guide](https://www.lisbonportugaltourism.com/guide/botanical-garden.html): Guide to Lisbon's Botanical Garden in Príncipe Real neighborhood
